glosses: access (a way or means of approaching)

examples.en: I have access to his library.

examples.text: Ele é sujeito a acessos de raiva.
examples.en: He is subject to fits of anger.

examples.text: Uma ponte dá acesso à ilha.
examples.en: A bridge gives access to the island.

examples.text: Nem todo mundo tem acesso à internet.
examples.en: Not everyone has access to the Internet.
How do I access the Internet?
